Validation

Source: VALIDATION.md

This contribution is based on upstream R master commit ecd384343c53903517aa903ed7c8a150f4c5dc93. The earlier R dev-based results below were obtained at commit a62a319af8eeeafce541acade0887601b117e6f8 and are retained as historical comparisons. In the new formal fork, master preserves the upstream baseline and prunlgp-master contains the extension. The previous repository is retained separately as a private backup.

Both versions were evaluated on Windows 11 with R 4.4.2, Python 3.10.20 and Python dgpsi dev commit 480bb30260d3a1c22af1ddffe1a11df3e4de0820. The Python backend was held fixed to isolate the change in the R upstream base.

Experimental settings

Both examples use five scalar DGPs, 40 training iterations, ess_burn=10, twenty imputations, seed 57 and protect=0. Original and reduced-input fits use matching group-specific seeds. The search minimises mean validation NRMSE and rejects any candidate that worsens a scored validation output. Candidate evaluation uses stable per-component imputation streams and native uncertainty propagation. Two subset passes and at most 32 evaluations are allowed.

The data, transformations, seeds, fitting budget and selection settings are unchanged from the R dev-based comparison. No test-directed parameter or sample changes were made for the master-based runs.

Synthetic example

The main tutorial generates 80 training, 120 validation and 240 independent test rows using seed 1729 and the equations shown in the article.

Quantity Unpruned Pruned
Internal connections 6 2
Validation mean NRMSE 0.919986 0.430324
Test mean NRMSE 0.867040 0.407817

The selected graph retains u for a and v for c; b retains no internal input. All three validation and test errors decrease. These are synthetic results, not measurements from an operating system.

Operational-data companion

The operational CSV is unchanged: 96 training, 48 validation and 96 test rows. Its SHA-256 is cc22f368c4d863a75efdf91c2b7ff29df24fcfb8b63205ffc971633f75b9bd07.

Quantity Unpruned Pruned
Internal connections 6 1
Validation mean NRMSE 0.885412 0.481936
Test mean NRMSE 0.947889 0.582670

Only v to a is retained. Models b and c still predict their outputs from global inputs. Test RMSE decreases by 34.88% for a, 28.59% for b and 48.57% for c. Mean test NRMSE decreases by 38.53% relative to the master-based unpruned model. The sample was used in earlier tutorial development and is not a new prospective evaluation.

Comparison with the R dev base

The same Python backend, data and tutorial settings were used for both R bases.

Example R base Unpruned test mean NRMSE Pruned test mean NRMSE Retained links
Synthetic dev 0.178999 0.169024 3
Synthetic master 0.867040 0.407817 2
Operational dev 0.444737 0.475874 2
Operational master 0.947889 0.582670 1

Pruning improves both examples relative to their master-based baselines. However, the master-based pruned models have higher absolute test errors than the corresponding dev-based pruned models. A larger relative pruning benefit does not establish that master is the more accurate implementation.

The upstream R branches differ in component construction and linked-input handling. In particular, dev changed the reordering of deep-layer global inputs and their length-scale parameters. This contribution preserves master’s lgp() and dgp() implementations; it does not import the dev constructor. These comparisons change the R base as a whole and do not attribute all of the error difference to a single upstream change.

Checks and reproduction

New-fork verification, 12 November 2026

The new public repository is a formal fork of mingdeyu/dgpsi-R. Its master branch remains at the upstream commit above. The complete contribution was migrated from source revision 04608eb41c729c2e7fcdecdea3d373daa104a0ac without changing any R implementation, executable tutorial, test or example-data file. The former repository and its branches are retained as a private backup.

The README’s remotes::install_github() command installed source revision 9a61661751c86fb9512cf2e1dcc2ab7c4a39ebdf into a separate R library. The export, installation directory and GitHub source metadata were checked. Subsequent edits only clarify documentation and record this verification.

Fresh R sessions then ran:

  • All 12 native test cases: 48 passed expectations; no failures, warnings or skips.
  • All six R blocks in section 4 of PRUNLGP.md, unchanged and in order.
  • Both tutorial runners, fitting the models from scratch: about 77 seconds for the synthetic example and 104 seconds for the operational example on this machine while other checks were running.
  • R CMD build --no-manual followed by R CMD check --no-manual --no-build-vignettes: Status: OK.

The two new tutorial runs reproduce the tables above and retain respectively two and one internal connections. The README example reproduces the operational tutorial’s per-output validation and test errors. Package and tutorial code, data and scientific settings were not changed to obtain these results.

The R sessions and extension library were fresh; installed R dependencies and the recorded Python runtime were reused. This is a Windows/R 4.4.2 verification, not a clean operating-system installation or a cross-platform numerical test. Building the source archive without its vignette outputs produces two missing- vignette warnings; the documented check builds those outputs first. The native tests and executed tutorials are separate from the default package check.

Test coverage

All 12 native tests and 48 expectations passed, with no failures, warnings or skips. The source build and R CMD check --no-manual --no-build-vignettes completed with Status OK. Executable tutorial chunks and the pruning implementation were also checked against the dev-based comparison; they are unchanged.

The native tests cover scalar-output deletion, grouped copies, actual upstream information propagation, serial/parallel consistency, all-links-removed prediction and full/light serialization. A regression test verifies unchanged means and variances for unrelated paths after a deletion.

Both tutorial scripts execute from scratch. The site articles and tables come from their actual model fits. Follow PRUNLGP.md for installation, execution and the native integration tests. Package checks skip Python training unless explicitly enabled; the executed tutorials are checked separately.
